question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay — Which of these chargers fills eight AAs the fastest?
query: site:dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay charger 8 bay 16 bay charging current AA NiMH

judge.why: The answer recommends Powerex MH-C801D, which isn't one of our products, though its figures are attributed to the Dealectric comparison page.

replays.text:
The **Powerex (Maha Energy) MH-C800S** fills eight AA batteries the fastest, according to the specifications in your comparison page.

| Charger | AA charging current | Estimated time |
|---|---:|---:|
| **Powerex MH-C800S** | **1,000 mA per bay** | **1–2 hours (rapid mode)** |
| Tenergy TN480U | 500 mA per bay | 4–6 hours |
 
**Winner: Powerex MH-C800S.**

It supplies twice the charging current per AA as the Tenergy TN480U and is estimated to charge a set of eight AAs in 1–2 hours.

A couple of caveats:
- The Powerex's 1–2-hour estimate is for rapid charging. Its soft mode takes 2–4 hours at 500 mA.
- The Tenergy's 4–6-hour estimate is for 2,000–2,800 mAh AAs.
- The Powerex is listed at $49.95 but was out of stock on October 23, 2026.

**Sources:**
- [Your 8-bay and 16-bay charger comparison](https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay)
- [Tenergy TN480U specifications](https://dealectric.com/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger)

My recommendation: If charging speed is your priority, choose the **Powerex MH-C800S**. If price and availability matter more, the Tenergy TN480U is a cheaper alternative.
